SpaceSystem.name: kfsw
SpaceSystem.LongDescription: K-FSW housekeeping. Generated by tools/ground/hk-report.py from the report definitions under ground-station/reports; edit those, not this file.

Parameter.name: gs_time_ms
Parameter.LongDescription: When the bridge says the sample was taken. The frame's own clock when it is set, the host clock when it is not.

Parameter.name: gs_sequence
Parameter.LongDescription: The frame's sequence, restated for Yamcs.

Parameter.name: hk_sequence
Parameter.LongDescription: Per-report counter. A gap here is a lost sample, not a lost value.

Parameter.name: hk_seconds
Parameter.LongDescription: UTC seconds when collection started, or zero if the node's clock was never set. A remote value cannot be simultaneous with anything, so this is a start, not a snapshot.

Parameter.name: hk_flags
Parameter.LongDescription: Incomplete means at least one value could not be read and was zero-filled. The frame does not say which one.

Parameter.name: nucleo_temperature_temp_mcu
Parameter.LongDescription: MCU die temperature. The die, not the board and not the air. Table 51 offset 0x00, temp_mcu_mc.

Parameter.name: nucleo_temperature_temp_valid
Parameter.LongDescription: Whether temp_mcu came from a sensor. Zero means the reading is the reserved value, not a cold spacecraft. Table 51 offset 0x10, temp_valid.

Parameter.name: nucleo_temperature_temp_failures
Parameter.LongDescription: Sensor reads that returned an error since boot. Table 51 offset 0x08, temp_failures.

Parameter.name: nucleo_temperature_uptime_s
Parameter.LongDescription: Seconds since boot. A reset shows here before anywhere else. Table 3 offset 0x00, uptime_s.

Parameter.name: nucleo_temperature_csp_buf_free
Parameter.LongDescription: Free CSP buffers. Housekeeping skips a sample when this reaches zero, so it explains a gap in the sequence numbers. Table 3 offset 0x0c, csp_buf_free.

SequenceContainer.name: hk_frame
SequenceContainer.LongDescription: The 12-byte bridge envelope and the 10-byte housekeeping header.

SequenceContainer.name: nucleo_temperature
SequenceContainer.LongDescription: Die temperature with the evidence needed to trust it, plus enough of the node to say whether the reading arrived from a healthy board.
